forum.content_text:
I use one Nucleo-F401RE create one project for TIM1-CH1-DMA, check RM0368 (rm0368-stm32f401xbc-and-stm32f401xde-advanced-armbased-32bit-mcus-stmicroelectronics.pdf) table 29, I can use DMA2\_stream 6.(support ch1,ch2,ch3)

When I open CUBEMX, there doesn’t support ch1, only support ch3, which one is correct CUBEMX or RM0368?
